item.title: India's NavIC gets its 4th satellite back, a 22,600-qubit plan to break RSA, and 8 new frontier items
item.description: Today: a code-breaking estimate that shrinks the quantum threat timeline, India's navigation satellite launch, a faster FDA path for custom gene editing, a Chinese AI chip that skips HBM, Mistral's open trillion-parameter model, RBI's cyber push and a blind patient's vision implant. Each item has an analogy, a readiness score and a plain-words urgency badge.

item.title: DNA that survives 400 years, a 5-in-a-million quantum error rate, and 21 new frontier breakthroughs across 8 topics
item.description: Today we expand beyond chips: medicine, brain interfaces, frontier AI, quantum, energy materials, DNA data storage and rockets. Each item is scored for readiness, with an analogy and a watch / small bet / wait plan.

item.title: Memory makers sell out to 2029, a photonic switch for AI racks, and 5 new chip ideas
item.description: SK hynix and Samsung say AI memory is sold out for years. PsiQuantum shows a light-based switch for AI networks. Plus four more new papers and products, each scored.

item.title: From lab paper to profit: 12 AI-chip breakthroughs to watch before the market does
item.description: Stock prices react to earnings. Earnings come from factories. Factories come from papers and patents published years earlier. We read those first.
